source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC WebUI, select Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, and check system information.
source_snapshot.criteria: System data is readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek substitutes a Redfish GET filtered to Model and Status for the required WebUI page. It neither proves the page renders nor defines all system fields that must be readable and correct.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs page renders the required System information legibly and that every displayed platform-defined field is correct for the intended SUT.
original_test_intent.target: The System section of the specified BMC WebUI page on the exact SUT/BMC firmware recipe, with any Redfish ComputerSystem resource used only as a corroborating source when the platform maps it to those UI fields.
original_test_intent.scope: Authenticate to the intended BMC, navigate the source-defined UI path, capture the complete System section and rendered labels/values/states, compare each required UI field with the signed platform inventory/specification and independent identity source, and optionally correlate mapped Redfish properties without replacing the UI check.
original_test_intent.operation: Confirm target identity and browser compatibility, open Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, wait for the System panel to finish loading, record the full rendered panel and DOM/text where available, verify readability and field completeness, compare each field against the owner matrix, collect a certificate-verified read-only Redfish member only for mapped cross-checks, and leave all state unchanged.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One complete observation of the System section after a fresh page load. The two-minute attended estimate and zero machine time do not justify limiting evidence to Model and Status or skipping the WebUI.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The correct target's System panel loads without UI/API error, every required field is visible, legible and non-stale, values match the platform specification/inventory and mapped backend source, sensitive identifiers are handled under the redaction policy, and no BMC/SUT state changes.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: BMC/SUT/firmware and WebUI build identity; signed required-field/expected-value/redaction matrix; timestamped full-page and System-panel capture; DOM/text or accessibility evidence; per-field comparison; mapped certificate-verified Redfish raw response if used; page/network errors and no-mutation confirmation.
ambiguities: The source does not enumerate which System fields the page must show or their authoritative expected values.
The source does not say that Redfish is the acceptance interface; DeepSeek and V2 promote it beyond the stated WebUI purpose.
The fixed `/redfish/v1/Systems/system` member ID may not be valid on this implementation.
Readability needs a rendered-page check; valid backend JSON cannot prove layout, truncation, localization or stale UI behavior.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 usefully adds target/member validation, protected transport, redaction and complete identity/status evidence. It changes the primary test from the named BMC WebUI System panel to a complete Redfish ComputerSystem resource and makes the actual UI optional; it also calls the case fully automatable while the platform-required UI field/expected-value matrix is still absent.

applicable_history.decision: The historical YES verdict accepts the API substitution and does not separately verify rendered WebUI readability.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Restore the BMC WebUI System panel as the primary acceptance surface and reclassify until its required-field/expected-value matrix and supported browser/access package are supplied. Redfish is valuable corroboration but cannot prove the required page is readable or correct.

available_now: The exact BMC WebUI navigation path and read-only presentation intent are known.
Target/BMC identity, WebUI build, TLS endpoint and discovered Redfish Systems collection can be inspected without state changes.
DMTF defines ComputerSystem as an API representation of a system and related data-plane resources; it does not define a vendor's WebUI layout or required displayed fields.
missing_inputs: Platform/BMC-firmware-specific list of required System panel labels, authoritative values, permitted omissions and readability/localization rules
Mapping from each UI field to platform inventory and, if applicable, the discovered Redfish ComputerSystem member/property; no fixed member ID may be assumed
Supported browser/automation version, WebUI route, load-completion/staleness rule, protected credentials, trusted TLS/certificate handling and screenshot/DOM redaction policy
Treatment of serial, UUID, asset and other sensitive identifiers plus owner-approved final comparison criteria
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/UI and platform owners supply the required-field and expected-value matrix and UI-to-source mapping; the lab/security owner supplies the target, protected credentials, TLS trust and artifact redaction policy.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Discover and record the intended BMC, firmware/WebUI build, trusted certificate and current page availability without changing system state.
Read the Redfish service root and Systems collection with certificate validation to identify candidate members; mark all UI-field mapping and acceptance as unresolved.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not substitute API JSON for the required rendered page, assume `/Systems/system`, accept only Model/Status, disable certificate verification as the sole method, or compare against an invented field list.
Do not click power/identify/reset controls, change inventory/asset data, clear logs, expose credentials or publish unredacted sensitive identifiers.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner matrix covers every required UI field and expected source; the correct member and target are discovered; the supported browser captures the complete rendered panel without truncation/staleness; TLS, credentials and redaction are validated; optional Redfish mappings are explicitly one-to-one.

revision_candidate.test_name: BMC WebUI System Inventory Readability and Accuracy
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify that the Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs > System panel is fully readable and that every required displayed value is correct for the intended SUT.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server, BMC firmware and WebUI build covered by an owner-approved System-panel field/value matrix, using a supported browser, protected read-only account, trusted TLS and redaction-aware evidence storage.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The complete System section in the source-named BMC WebUI page. A discovered Redfish ComputerSystem resource may corroborate mapped fields but is not a replacement for rendered UI evidence.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/BMC identity; WebUI build and route; required field/expected value/allowed omission matrix; UI-to-authoritative-source and optional Redfish mapping; browser/automation package; page-complete/stale rules; TLS trust, credentials and sensitive-field redaction policy.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Open the resolved BMC WebUI, navigate to Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, wait for the System panel's approved completion signal, capture the full rendered panel plus DOM/accessibility text, and compare every required label/value/state with the signed matrix. If approved, discover the correct Redfish Systems member and use a certificate-verified GET only to corroborate explicitly mapped fields.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct BMC/SUT and firmware confirmed; required-field matrix approved; browser and page route validated; target is not undergoing update/reset; TLS trust and protected credentials work; clocks and evidence storage are ready; redaction rules are active.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: BMC/SUT/WebUI identity; signed matrix; full timestamped System-panel screenshot and DOM/text evidence; per-field legibility/completeness/value result; mapped independent inventory or Redfish evidence with discovered member URI; page/API errors; sensitive-field redaction and no-mutation proof.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform/BMC WebUI System inventory specification and signed expected-value matrix. DMTF Redfish ComputerSystem defines an API resource, not the vendor UI's visual acceptance criteria.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read-only navigation and GET only. Never assume a fixed member, bypass TLS without an approved trust method, invoke UI controls/actions, modify asset/power/BIOS/OS state, clear logs, expose credentials or release sensitive identifiers unredacted.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No disruptive-action approval is needed; the platform/BMC owner must confirm the required-field matrix and source mapping before final acceptance.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The owner defines correctness and sensitive-field policy. Browser navigation, rendered/DOM capture, mapped read-only Redfish collection and comparison can be automated; a human resolves visual defects or platform-specific omissions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No mutation is expected. On wrong target, authentication/TLS anomaly, incomplete/stale page, browser failure or BMC instability, stop, preserve evidence, close the session and follow the approved read-only management-access recovery path without power/reset actions.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong or ambiguous BMC/System member, missing field matrix, unsupported WebUI/browser, incomplete or unreadable panel, stale/loading error, unexpected value without authoritative source, TLS/credential concern, sensitive-data leakage risk or any requested state-changing action.

identified_defects: V2 makes a complete Redfish ComputerSystem response the primary test although the source explicitly requires a BMC WebUI page.
DeepSeek's Model/Status filter is insufficient and its fixed member plus `-k` handling may be wrong for the implementation.
The platform-required UI fields and expected values are absent, so current execution readiness is not FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
reason_for_change: Prevent an API-only false completion by restoring rendered WebUI readability and correctness as the actual acceptance target, retaining Redfish only for explicitly mapped corroboration, and separating the missing field/spec/browser inputs from technical capability.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide, DSP2046 2025.2
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Redfish services implementing the advertised ComputerSystem schema version
new_technical_evidence.supports: ComputerSystem represents a system instance and linked software-visible resources at `/redfish/v1/Systems/{ComputerSystemId}`; the member identifier is parameterized and must be discovered rather than assumed as `system`.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The vendor WebUI field set, rendering, and UI-to-Redfish mapping are outside the generic schema and remain platform-specific.

removed_ambiguities: Makes the rendered WebUI panel primary and API evidence secondary.
Requires discovery of the correct ComputerSystem member rather than a fixed URI.
Defines readability, completeness, correctness and redaction as separate evidence dimensions.
resolved_blockers: The workflow is technically automatable with a supported browser and read-only APIs; missing platform field expectations are provisionable inputs rather than a semantic BLOCKED condition.
remaining_blockers: Final execution/acceptance awaits the required UI-field/expected-value matrix, supported browser/page completion method, target/member mapping, trusted access and redaction policy.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 restores the source-mandated WebUI presentation test that V2 made optional, prevents API-only false completion and fixed-member assumptions, and correctly gates missing platform expectations without declaring the intent irreducibly blocked.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently retained the complete rendered System panel, visual plus DOM/text evidence, authoritative per-field matrix, discovered-only Redfish corroboration and no page-load-only PASS.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The procedure explicitly navigates BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs and the criterion requires System data to be readable and correct.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 improves API completeness but makes the actual WebUI check optional and assumes a complete ComputerSystem resource is the test target.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Permit only read-only browser/GET evidence, restore the rendered panel as primary, require a signed field/value matrix and prohibit UI actions, fixed member guesses, TLS/credential shortcuts or unredacted release.
